title.en: International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization) Order 1971

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization) Order 1971.

heading.en: Status of Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization

text.en:
2.—(1) The Southeast Asian Ministers of Education Organization (called in this Order the Organization) is an organisation of which the Government and the governments of foreign sovereign Powers are members.
(2) The Organization has the legal capacities of a body corporate.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of the Organization

text.en:
3.—(1) The property and assets of the Organization enjoy immunity from legal process, except insofar as in any particular case the Organization has expressly waived its immunity.
(2) The Organization has the like inviolability of its official archives as is accorded in respect of the official archives of an envoy of a foreign sovereign Power accredited to the Government.
(3) The Organization has the like exemption or relief from taxes and rates, other than taxes on the importation of goods, as is accorded to a foreign sovereign Power.
(4) The Organization has exemption from taxes on the importation of —
(a)goods directly imported by the Organization for its official use in Singapore or for exportation; and
(b)any of the publications of the Organization directly imported by it,
subject to compliance with any condition that the Director‑General of Customs may prescribe for the protection of the revenue.
(5) The Organization has exemption from prohibitions and restrictions on importation or exportation —
(a)in the case of goods directly imported or exported by the Organization for its official use; and
(b)in the case of any publication of the Organization directly imported or exported by it.
(6) The Organization has the right to avail itself —
(a)for telegraphic communications sent by it and containing only matter intended for publication by the press; or
(b)for broadcasting (including communication addressed to or despatched from places outside Singapore),
of any reduced rate applicable for the corresponding service in the case of press telegrams.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of representatives of members
Immunities and privileges of Director of Secretariat of the Organization

text.en:
5. Except insofar as in any particular case any privilege or immunity is waived by the Organization, the Director of the Secretariat of the Organization is accorded in respect of himself or herself —
(a)the like immunity from suit and legal process; and
(b)the like exemption or relief from taxes,
as are accorded to an envoy of a foreign sovereign Power accredited to the Government.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of officials of the Organization

text.en:
6.—(1) Officials of the Organization who are part of the International Staff of the Organization and whose names are communicated to and approved by the Government enjoy exemption from income tax in respect of emoluments received by them as officials of the Organization.
(2) In this Order, “officials of the Organization” includes experts and consultants performing missions for the Organization.
